release_title: TopUp Net Gateway v1.0.5 (Background Reliability & SMS Scanner)
changelog:
- Fixed Gateway credentials persistence across Admin Panel & Companion App
- Automatic service restart on task removal from Recents & Boot Completed receiver
- Missed/Delayed SMS Inbox Scanner with 24h recovery & periodic background sync
- Fixed white-on-white text readability in dark theme input fields
- Developer Contact button directly opens Telegram (@itsnayon360)
- 100% Production Signed Release Build
